item.summary: fix(ui): make chat activity less visually noisy (#120371) * fix(ui): refine chat avatar and activity grouping Inset the bundled mascot without affecting custom avatars, and roll consecutive tool activity groups into one expandable presentation row while preserving turn and error semantics. * fix(ui): keep activity run type internal
